HV-R2-RESULT-PART 005
view to Finalizing. FR-012-AC007 is wholly assigned to HvStorageSchema although it asserts every guarded write and admission refusal, whose wiring and admission unit arrive in H2. A 133-of-133 allocation count therefore does not establish the stated production dependency rule. P7 also has no named test or explicit named traceability check assigned to its correction.
Evidence: The independent phase parser confirms 133 criteria bound exactly once, with zero missing/duplicate/undefined ids. These two counterexamples follow the command ownership and phase descriptions, not a demand for live-server tests at H1. The H1 harness distinction and H6-before-H5 ordering are correct. Searches for P7/EventStreamController show a correction task and broad G5 gate, but no named case for that problem.
Change to PASS: Move each whole criterion to a phase where its complete production behavior exists, or split the criterion with explicit phase-specific assertions and named tests while preserving all original behavior. Put the no-record Review case in H7 and the migration guard/admission behavior after H2. Name the P7 traceability verification. Synchronize section 19.4 and both TODO projections; retain the correct H1 harness and H6/H5 ordering.

UNKNOWN list: empty. Operator-decision failures: none. D-03 remains the intentionally open operator approval decision; no new decision or lowered gate is needed to repair these findings.

Round 1 closure, one entry per item:

- F01: PASS. Independent flush timer handles one line followed by silence; 1469/1512 and FR-008-AC001/003.

- F02: PASS. R-30 and WatchHvNotifications use one atomic cursor/inbox state, submitting turn identity and honest at-least-once prompt delivery; FR-017-AC005 to AC007.

- F03: PASS. UpdateHvReviewerCommand durably increments configuration and requests qualification; FR-001-AC005 and startup initial qualification.

- F04: FAIL. Successful stale close is fixed, but stale failure/shutdown/expiry readiness paths remain unguarded: R2-F01.

- F05: PASS. FailHvRunCommand now has a separate Probe branch, does not call the request-only retry policy, and explicitly re-requests on shutdown. New restart loop is R2-F02.

- F06: PASS. V-6 requires a completed Chore turn containing every reviewer record in order; FR-010-AC008.

- F07: PASS. Stored Result excludes its own digest; public projection adds ResultSha256; FR-011-AC006.

- F08: PASS. FileHvIncidentCommand records its filing attempt under the audit guard before triage, then commits Filed and notification together; FR-009-AC007.

- F09: PASS. P1 now distinguishes stale exported checked text from live criterion 4 isSatisfied false; store and REMED agree.

- F10: FAIL. Internal input/transaction/state changes are fixed, but retained foundation sequences and grader status are not reconciled: R2-F07.

- F11: FAIL. Response shape is expanded, but closed finding persistence and NotGraded result shape still contradict the complete contract: R2-F06.

- F12: FAIL. V-3/V-8 now bind the admitted set; V-4/R-31 still rejects a legitimate grade after mutable response closure: R2-F05.

- F13: PASS. R-31 is now the common overall predicate and FR-010-AC009 tests mixed scopes. Its separate commit-time race is R2-F05.

- F14: PASS. RecordHvRunStartCommand owns Claimed-to-Running, StartedUtc and ProcessId before the brief append; FR-007-AC009.

- F15: PASS. Close serializes with cancel and honors CancelRequested; repeat cancel of CancelRequested/Canceled returns unchanged 200; FR-008-AC012.

- F16: PASS. Removal metadata ownership and every removed-payload read outcome are specified; FR-019-AC005.

- F17: PASS. VI-05 counts timer and byte-triggered appends under a stated workload, not an interval-imposed maximum.

- F18: FAIL. A separate worker is now named but its lease, terminal-state and DTO contracts are incomplete: R2-F03; P5 still contradicts its selection rule: R2-F04.

- F19: PASS. Adapters own worker-bound containment and descendant cleanup after root exit, with FR-007-AC008/FR-008-AC011; no review deadline is imposed.

- F20: PASS. Plugin key is bounded hv- plus a 32-character hash over full submitting identity, scope, context and format; FR-020-AC006.

- F21: PASS. Fail checks OutputClosed, Finalizing and StateVersion transactionally and returns already_completed without writes after a concurrent success; FR-012-AC008. Caller propagation is a separate R2-F09 defect.

- U01: PASS. GitHub server activity matches the original ten-entry audit and all later normal pushes, through 6c848a4e.

- U02: FAIL. Complete syntactic allocation and H1/H6 corrections are present, but production dependencies still fail R2-F12.

Per-requirement what-if pass (FR-MCP-HVPIPE prefix, corresponding TR/TEST edges independently checked):

- 001: PATCH/configuration versions, enabled state and startup replay traced; stale failures and failed-probe restart fail R2-F01/F02.

- 002: submitter/author aliases, unknown identity, no eligible reviewer, round-robin restart and cross-workspace isolation have named coverage; no additional defect.

- 003: nonce mismatch, missing runtime proof, unsupported logging, reconfiguration, process failure and restart traced; R2-F01/F02/F11 remain.

- 004: turn/range/session boundaries, submitting-turn exclusion, nonterminal turns, limit, snapshot and later-arriving turns have explicit outcomes.

- 005: overlapping admission, idempotent repeat, changed payload, unavailable reviewers and bounded plugin key traced; R1 key defect fixed.

- 006: malformed/unresolved requirement references and secret-redacted context have stated outcomes and named coverage; no additional defect.

- 007: claim/start/restart/lease takeover/late writes traced; run-start and owner-death fixes pass; artifact reuse and finalizer caller outcomes fail R2-F03/F09.

- 008: quiet single line, byte bursts, no execution deadline, cancellation at heartbeat/close, isolated plugin state and descendant cleanup traced; live timer/cancel/containment contract passes.

- 009: reviewer versus server blame, attempts exhausted, triage outage and ledger failure traced; incident write-ahead passes; stale probe attribution and caller failure propagation remain.

- 010: malformed/missing/duplicate records, score-only and mixed verdicts, completed reviewer turn and concurrent finalizers traced; R2-F05/F09/F11/F12 remain.

- 011: corrupt/missing/reordered chunks, multi-member GZIP, digest projection, append failure and result compression traced; R2-F10/F11 remain.

- 012: pending/final write guards, cancel release, migration, injected commit failure and late verification failure traced; late overwrite fixed; real migration acceptance dependency fails R2-F12.

- 013: absent/varying self-review and independent snapshot/assessment criteria traced; no HV self-review dependency found.

- 014: passing/failing results and TODO references traced; no HV unit writes TODO state.

- 015: complete request/output/failure projection, query paging, missing/active result and removal traced; response disposition/findings and codec outcomes fail R2-F06/F10.

- 016: event replay, quiet producer, reconnect, attempt transition, malformed cursor and removed evidence traced; internal/read corruption continuation remains R2-F10.

- 017: cursor/inbox crash windows, completion before submit returns, replay/deduplication and prompt-delivery crash traced; one-state-file and at-least-once corrections pass.

- 018: each mutation, public/internal evidence read, ledger outage, incident write-ahead and removal traced; internal read audit fails R2-F08.

- 019: old evidence, active request refusal, explicit removal/repeat, retained ledger and subsequent reads traced; closed-response findings are not preserved as required in R2-F06.

- 020: REST/MCP/client/REPL/Director/plugin parity, internal-unit exclusion, host binding and idempotency boundaries traced; grade and error contract propagation fail R2-F07/F09/F10.

- 021: Mode Off, reject/supersede dur
